hml.text: Ulgrotha was ruined when the Tolgath and the Ancients waged war and the Tolgath Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime, ending the war but devastating the whole plane.
The Chime killed all creatures, leaving the Dead Zone, and Ravi hid in a coffin and could not free herself, while dwarves from another plane dug through a gate and founded New Freedom.
Feroz found the ruined plane and married Serra, and together they cast a magical barrier, Feroz's Ban, over the world to guard it from planeswalkers.

But Feroz died in a laboratory accident, and Baron Sengir manipulated the grieving Serra into leaving, so the Ban began to fail and civilizations fought each other while Sengir plotted to take control.
